S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  Time Extension Application (IA) No.2 of 2024  In  BA3 No.11 of 2024

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Mayank Joshi, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. with Mr. Vipul Painuli, Brief Holder for the State.

The applicant Mohd.
Wasim was granted short term bail on 28.02.2024 in FIR No.640 of 2021, dated 11.11.2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Sections 5/6 of The Protection Of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: Protection Of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
The applicant was granted short term bail on the ground of his neurological problems.

It is argued that the applicant is still under treatment at Dr. Susheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani, District Nainital.

entities.text:
Susheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani, District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: His next date is fixed for another review is 26.03.2024.
The short term bail granted to the applicant is extended to a further period of 02 weeks from the date of its expiry.
It is further directed that, on expiry of the duration of extended short term bail, the applicant shall surrender the court concerned and intimation to that effect shall also be given to this Court.
The time extension application stands disposed of accordingly.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 15.03.2024 Sanjay BA3/11/2024 on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182967102/
